description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarFieldWysiwyg class, specifically testing TinyMCE editor initialization, error handling, and configuration within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarFieldWysiwygTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SugarFieldWysiwyg, testing TinyMCE integration and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of SugarFieldWysiwyg.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyHandlesTinyMCEError
methods.description: Tests error handling when TinyMCE configuration throws a RuntimeException.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyWithFormName
methods.description: Checks the selector string when a formName is provided.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyWithoutFormName
methods.description: Checks the selector string when no formName is provided.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyIncludesJavaScriptStructure
methods.description: Ensures the generated TinyMCE init JavaScript contains expected structures.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyIncludesHeightOverride
methods.description: Verifies height configuration is included in the TinyMCE config.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyLogsInfo
methods.description: Confirms info-level logging when loading the editor.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyFallsBackToParentOnError
methods.description: Ensures fallback behavior when TinyMCE configuration fails.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyCallsSetup
methods.description: Verifies that the setup method is called before TinyMCE initialization.

methods.name: testGetEditViewSmartyUsesCorrectFieldName
methods.description: Checks that the field name from vardef is correctly used in the editor selector.
